sentences.en: He showed his kung fu skills by breaking a board with his bare hands.
sentences.zh: 他徒手打破了木板，展示了功夫技能。

sentences.en: The movie featured a lot of impressive kung fu scenes.
sentences.zh: 这部电影有很多令人印象深刻的功夫场景。

sentences.en: Learning kung fu requires years of practice and dedication.
sentences.zh: 学习功夫需要多年的练习和奉献。
